| Property| Description|
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| MunicipalityGuids| The GUID associated to the local authority. Filterable|
| SharedContainerGuid| The GUID associated to the shared container.| 
| ClusterAccountId| The id associated to the shared container.|
| SharedContainer| The NAME associated to the shared container.| 
| Containers[0].ContainerGuid| The GUID of the container associated to the shared container.|
| Container[0].Tag| The Tag of the container associated to the shared container.| 
| Container[0].SerialNo| The SerialNo of the container associated to the shared container.| 
| Container[0].AccessPassRequired| The AccessPassRequired of the container associated to the shared container.| 
| MasterAccessPasses[0].AccessPassTagId| The AccessPassTagId of the local authority associated to the shared container.| 
| MasterAccessPasses[0].MasterAccessPassGuid| The GUID of the access pass associated to the shared container.| 
| Accounts[0].ClusterAccountId| The id associated to the shared container.| 
| Accounts[0].CustomerId| The id of the customer associated to the shared container.|
| Accounts[0].CustomerGuid| The GUID of municipal account associated to the shared container.| 
| Accounts[0].MunicipalAccountAccessPasses[0].MunicipalAccessPassGuid| The GUID of the access pass of municipal account associated to the shared container.|
| Accounts[0].MunicipalAccountAccessPasses[0].AccessPassTagId| The AccessPassTagId of the access pass of municipal account associated to the shared container.|
